show.summary: A modest employee of the research institute, Oleg Tyapin, is unexpectedly elected to the Duma of the new convocation. He doesn't want to be a deputy at all, but duty is duty - Tyapin leaves provincial Glebov for Moscow to take on new responsibilities. The hero will go through all the stages of development and formation of himself as a new person, fall in love, and most importantly, experience a lot of comical situations.

show.name: История его служанки
show.summary:
Moscow, 19th century. Lush balls, the glamour of estates, and behind-the-scenes intrigues. The young and eligible bachelor Count Nikolai Sheremetyev returns to the world of high society after the war. His arrival ignites the social circles, as mothers and daughters plot to secure a wealthy husband. However, things become more complicated for Nikolai, as his mother's will requires him to marry within a year, or he will lose his inheritance. Meanwhile, the Averin family finds themselves on the brink of ruin due to the family's gambling debts. Their daughter, Anna, a stubborn and witty noblewoman, decides to meet the count personally, hoping he will forgive their debt.

 Sheremetyev, a man of principles, offers a deal: a year of Anna's service at his estate. Thus, Anna becomes the count's most unusual servant. As she adjusts to her new role, various suitors arrive at Nikolai's home. However, the more time they spend together, the more difficult it becomes to conceal their mutual attraction. In the meantime, the stories unfold between Anna's younger brother, Roma, and the daughter of wealthy neighbors, Yulia, as well as between Elena and Averin, a couple whose marriage teeters on the brink of collapse but still holds a flickering spark.

show.name: Swallowed Star

Infected animals mutated into terrible monsters, invaded massively, and humans built walls around the destruction and established the base city as the last bastion for humans. The suffering that mankind has experienced during this period of time is known as the "Great Nirvana Period." Not only that, Luo Feng not only carried the burden of supporting the family but also to protect the human homeland, for the better survival and development of mankind, together with other justice warriors, to join hands against the fierce monsters. Under the desperate situation of the end, can Luo Feng and other warriors repel monsters and successfully protect the human world?

show.name: Love Island Australia
show.summary:
Taking the hottest international reality show format right now and unleashing it on 9GO!, the multi-million-dollar stripped format commission, Love Island Australia, will see sexy young Aussie singles on the lookout for romance, jetting off to a summer paradise to find love in the sun in Spain.

Not only must they must choose their partner wisely and stay the course as sexy new singles enter the island, but they also must win the hearts of the public, convincing them – and themselves – that their newfound love is real.

Throughout weeks of dates, challenges, eliminations and sexy new singles, all in front of our eyes, viewers will get to decide who they want to stay, who they want to boot, and ultimately who they want to crown the hottest couple on Love Island Australia. The winning couple are handed a pot of money to start their new lives together, but there's a catch: one is given the chance to share the money or walk away with it all for them self. Were they after love or money all along?

show.name: Yi Nian Yong Heng
show.summary:
One will to create oceans. One will to summon the mulberry fields.

One will to slaughter countless devils. One will to eradicate innumerable immortals.

Only my will… is eternal.

A Will Eternal tells the tale of Bai Xiaochun, an endearing but exasperating young man who is driven primarily by his fear of death and desire to live forever, but who deeply values friendship and family.

(Source: Novel Updates)

show.name: When I Meet the Moon
show.summary: The socially anxious Yun Li applies for a postgraduate program in Nanwu to prove her independence to her father. A day before the semester begins, she is invited to a local virtual reality (VR) center as a video creator. There, she reunites with Fu Shize, the genius and her high school crush. She gradually opens up, and, with the help of others, goes all out to court her dream man, winning him over with her warmth and radiance. However, amid the loving moments, their differing perspectives eventually lead to a breakup. When she goes abroad, his deeply suppressed trauma is brought to the forefront. To win her back, he gets back on his feet, leading his team to new heights in scientific research. When she returns to China, he pursues her relentlessly, and the two overcome their differences and rekindle their love.

To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film "The Rose" as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate.

show.name: 10's Late News
show.summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

show.name: The Silent Storm
show.summary: In 1994, tax auditor Ouyang Xu, criminal investigator Yan Ping'an, and Zhou Haiyang—who was searching for his missing wife—met through a counterfeit invoice case in Chunjiang City. Under the tide of the times, the three experienced vastly different circumstances, and their fates gradually diverged. Years later, Operation Grain Rain brings them together again—but the brothers of old now stand on opposite sides. Ouyang Xu faces off against the tax fraud ring led by Zhou Haiyang and the protective umbrella behind it, caught in a painful choice between emotion and the law. Starting from a single invoice, he tears away the veil of greed and ultimately eliminates evil, safeguarding justice.

show.summary: STAT is a look into the daily lives of staff members at St-Vincent Hospital in Montreal. body.name: Boston Celtics at Philadelphia 76ers
body.summary:
In the first game against his former team that he spent the first decade of his NBA career with, Jaylen Brown and the 76ers (8-1) host Jayson Tatum and the Boston Celtics (6-2) from Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, Pa.

Brown, who was drafted by the Celtics in 2016, spent the first decade of his career in Boston and earned five All-Star selections and two All-NBA selections. His tenure in Boston culminated in helping to lead the franchise to its 18th championship in franchise history in 2024, where he was named Finals MVP. This will be Brown's first game against his former team since being traded to Philadelphia this offseason, and his first career matchup against former teammate and six-time All-Star Jayson Tatum, with whom he shared the court for nine seasons.

Philadelphia leads the Eastern Conference and has won five consecutive games, including recent victories over the defending NBA champion Knicks and Pistons. Two-time NBA All-Star Tyrese Maxey ranks sixth in the NBA in scoring (28.0 points per game), while four-time NBA MVP LeBron James continues to seamlessly integrate in his first season as a 76er. The Celtics sit in third in the Eastern Conference standings, with Tatum being named Eastern Conference Player of the Week (Oct. 26-Nov. 1) and joining Naismith Basketball Hall of Famers Larry Bird and John Havlicek as the only Boston players to average 28+ points and 7+ assists through the first six games of a season.

body.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Portland Trail Blazers
body.summary:
NBA MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Oklahoma City Thunder (6-2) visit nine-time NBA All-Star Damian Lillard and the Portland Trail Blazers (6-1) from Moda Center in Portland, Oregon. 

The Thunder are coming off two consecutive wins over the Cavaliers, in which Gilgeous-Alexander scored a game-high 43 and 42 points in the two contests. The four-time NBA All-Star, in the wake of losing Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren, and Cason Wallace to injury, has ramped up his offensive production, ranking second in the league in scoring (30.1 PPG). Lillard, in his first season back after an Achilles injury, leads a revitalized Portland team that's tied for first in the Western Conference. Along with 2026 NBA All-Star Deni Avdija, the Trail Blazers have already notched victories over the Lakers and Nuggets this season.
